definition: Agent experience (AX) is the design of digital environments in which AI agents can understand, navigate, and act effectively.
details: The term can also refer to the appearance and affordances of an environment from a machine-user's point of view. In other words, the experience AI agents have as users of platforms and products; in this sense it has a close parallel with user experience (UX). Less often, the term spans the experience of collaborating with AI agents from the human perspective.
story: Picture hiring a brilliant new assistant on their first morning — smart, motivated, but with no idea how anything in your office actually works. Think of it this way: Agent experience (AX) is the design of digital environments in which AI agents can understand, navigate, and act effectively. And here is the clever part: The term can also refer to the appearance and affordances of an environment from a machine-user's point of view. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Agent experience.
